horoscope: Early today, the Moon encourages a need to connect with others, dear Aries, and cultivating true friendships can be rewarding now. As the day advances, you can quickly become all wound up mentally. Ideally, some great ideas can come out of this kind of tension. Fortunately, it's a generally strong time for working on pet projects or studies, as you can be super motivated to put time and effort into your work and interests. You have a special way with words today, and you may be recognized for your insight, wit, intelligence, and concern or care. Your ability to get to the point is strong, and your ability to see what others may need is powerful as well. Even so, the Moon heads into your privacy sector, and low-profile activities are a strong draw. You can really benefit from private time.

Early today, the Moon encourages your focus on meeting your responsibilities, stepping up to the plate, and putting yourself out there, dear Taurus. It's a time to aim for more integrity in your image or work. As the day advances, however, you crave more interaction or a focus on your social life and happiness goals. Aim to stretch your mind while keeping your feet on the ground. Great ideas usually go through many transformations before reaching their potential. Fortunately, you benefit from a transit that motivates you to make yourself more secure, and if this means working harder to make more money, then so be it. You are feeling particularly independent and focused. This is also a good time for releasing resentment or negative feelings to move past or beyond an emotionally “stuck” place.

Strong energy is with you for nurturing and developing your pet projects or work, dear Gemini. Conditions and people in your life seem to support your efforts, or at least allow you the pleasure of doing what you want to do without guilt or distraction. You could be motivated to work harder because of clear goals or to better take care of you and yours. There is a real protector in you these days. Early today, the Moon encourages you to reach beyond your usual limits or routines. It's a time to consider ways to nourish your spirit. As the day advances, however, the Moon heads into your solar tenth house, and your larger goals or long-term plans are a focal point, motivating you.

You are in better touch with your deeper feelings today, dear Cancer. This is also a good time for career developments or moves. People look at you with more respect, as you have special executive ability and can easily manage others in fair ways. You have a way of being practical, calm, persistent, and sensible, and these things earn you natural respect. Early today, the Moon encourages special attention to your spiritual and emotional needs, even when dealing with your practical affairs. As the day advances, mental restlessness can lead to positive experiences, particularly if it compels you to seek out new and interesting information or interests. Discipline, however, can be lacking if you are required to focus on dry or monotonous work. Happily, the Moon's move to your spirit sector boosts your mood, bringing fresh energy to your life. You are looking to move outside of your routine.

Early today, the Moon encourages you to find a balanced perspective, dear Leo, or to balance your life by sharing. Reaching a compromise can be satisfying now. You can be providing support today in a great range of positions or roles, in fact. You instinctively know that there are learning experiences to be found virtually everywhere, and today, opportunities are rich through friends or networking activities. This is a more sociable day than most, and it makes sense to open the lines of communication, as opportunities to advance your current interests and to welcome new people and experiences abound now. Even so, decisions made as the day advances could run counter to what's in your heart, so it makes sense to wait and see if possible.

Early today, the Moon encourages attention to your routines, work, and health, dear Virgo. The more you put into these things, the more they give back with the North Node now in your solar sixth house. It can be a bit of a juggle, but balancing your genuine needs for self-service and service to others is important now. The Moon then moves into your opposing sign, and you might find yourself making accommodations or compromises more than you normally would. Interactions can be very revealing of what's going on beneath the surface. If your life can benefit from doing some research or investigating a particular topic further, today is an excellent time to dig in. You are in a great position to look for answers, and your eye for uncovering the right information is keen. The day also favors work in general, as well as nurturing relationships with superiors or people who can help you achieve your goals.

Early today, the Moon encourages you to pay due attention to your personal life, dear Libra. You might choose to temporarily downplay your obligations to the outside world so that you can develop your love relationships or enjoy some personal time and creative outlets. Instead, it can be a time to find your creative voice or discover and share your unique talents. However, as the day advances, you can become more and more interested in producing and solving problems. Even so, it can be a powerful day for nurturing your relationships, as your dedication is clear (or that of a partner or friend), and this can help strengthen a bond and enhance a feeling of camaraderie. Someone may be bringing out the very best in you. If there is a relationship that needs some extra care, this can be a good time to pay it the attention it deserves. It’s also a strong time for promotional activities.

Your desire to help and support others is strong today, dear Scorpio. You can go to great lengths to find the information you need to help someone you care about, and can easily get a bit carried away with research or delving a little more deeply into whatever topic or project you’re currently interested in. The North Node of the Moon recently moved into your home and family sector, and early today, the Moon aligns with it. This transit comes at a time when there is much energy in your sector of career, direction, life path, responsibility, and reputation, and you're now encouraged to find a balance. This way, you can bring back a more rested, balanced self to your work, goals, and obligations. As the day advances, you prefer to let your thoughts roam more freely. Emotional energy turns outward with the Moon moving into your playful solar fifth house.

Your powers of attraction and personal magnetism are strong, dear Sagittarius, and your own feelings tend to match the intensity you’re projecting. Others are seeing your value more than usual, so that relationships of all kinds can benefit. Repairing and strengthening your friendships and partnerships can be in focus. You are not only received well, you’re also finding more value in the connections you make. Early today, the Moon encourages you to gently challenge yourself through learning, communication, and connecting. It's a time to develop your communication skills and sensitize yourself to others' needs and views. As the day advances, you're seeking a little more familiarity and comfort. There is good energy for asserting your needs and wants, largely because you are suddenly more aware of them, in a close relationship.

Early today, working on self-acceptance is in favor, dear Capricorn. The Moon aligns with its North Node in your solar second house, reminding you of the benefits of centering yourself and recognizing your need for security and comfort. As the day advances, people can be rougher around the edges in spots, but you're also a little more mentally curious. Fortunately, today brings good energy for emotional connections and the work that goes into making relationships healthy and satisfying. It’s also a fine time for putting in extra energy when it comes to personal interests, work, and fitness or other health programs and routines. You’re motivated to provide, support, and nurture the people you love and to honor the processes that help you and yours thrive.

This can be a wonderful day for finding new ways to communicate, dear Aquarius, as well as to show how much you care about someone through your words or simply the act of reaching out and making a connection. You may be in the position of go-between now. Early today, the Moon encourages you to explore and develop your independence. You're more expressive today, and you find strength in being self-reliant. As the day advances, you're seeking a little more predictability. However, you can sometimes feel a bit torn, as your instincts may be telling you something and people are telling you a different story. Later today is good for discussing strategies for reaching your goals.

There is a strong focus on making life more secure and fulfilling today, dear Pisces. A happy and safe environment at home can be a prime motivator now, and you seem to have the support of others and circumstances to find ways to improve your well-being. You can also be experiencing deeper desires and a need for a stronger connection with someone special. The Moon begins the day in your privacy zone, aligning with the North Node there and encouraging you to give due attention to your inner world. Aim to let go of unnecessary worry and guilt to clear your vision. However, as the day advances, watch that you don't burn out by attempting too much or by setting over-the-top goals for yourself. The Moon heads into your sign, and you can feel as if you're beginning fresh. While there can be some tension with a higher-up or impatience and frustration with schedules and rules, good energy is with you for the motivation to get important things done. There can be an urgency felt now when it comes to fulfilling your emotional needs, but taming this a little can go a long way towards greater happiness today. Be moderate, but listen closely to the feelings that surface now.
